Overview.Name: Sreekanth Maharaju
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal

Meal_1: Option 1: Egg omelette (2 eggs) & vegetable dosa (1)
Option 2: Idli (2) & sambar (1 cup) & paneer cubes (60 g)
Option 3: Vegetable upma (medium bowl) & grilled chicken (small portion)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (palm size) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) & dal (1 bowl) & spinach curry
Option 3: 2 chapati & grilled chicken (moderate portion) & salad
Meal_3: Option 1: Cooked rice (1/2 cup cooked ~75 g) & chicken curry (light) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Paneer stir fry (60 g) & cucumber salad
Option 3: Clear vegetable soup (1 large bowl) & grilled chicken (small portion)

Notes_and_Tips: Avoid reused oil foods completely as mentioned and prefer fresh pan cooked meals.
Since disk bulge is present, keep meals lighter at night to reduce discomfort and support recovery.
For physique improvement, keep protein portions strong and rice moderate.
Cravings can be managed by choosing makhana or chicken instead of fried outside food.
Simple home style cooking will help you stay consistent even with long work hours.
